Request on WhatsApp Request by email

No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

In this session you understand government roles, eligibility and hiring routes.

It can be booked by one person or by a class. A short form before the session lets the mentor prepare for you.

What it covers

  • Roles & eligibility
  • Official notices
  • Application readiness

How the time is spent

  1. Roles & eligibility 22 min

    Differentiate ASI, museums, universities and contract posts.

    You: roles table

  2. Official notices 45 min

    Read criteria from actual/current advertisement; no evergreen promises.

    You: eligibility checker

  3. Application readiness 23 min

    Knowledge/skills portfolio and study plan.

    You: action list

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Diagnose participant goals and constraints based on a pre-session questionnaire.
  • Understand government roles, eligibility and hiring routes.
  • Leave with personalised recommendations and follow-up actions linked to verified sources.

You take away

A personal action plan with dates and checked sources.
